content.text: {"id": "mm5350a2", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Of these injuries, 28 (65%) were identified as unintentional; 19 (68%) of those met the case definition"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Seven (37%) persons who sustained injuries from celebratory gunfire were female, compared with three (13%) females"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Four (21%) persons were hospitalized, including one who died from a head injury"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Four (21%) persons who sustained injuries from celebratory gunfire were children aged <15 years"}]}, {"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Four public housing areas accounted for eight (42%) cases"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Of the 19 injuries, 18 (95%) occurred in metropolitan San Juan"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The most common body location for injury from celebratory gunfire was the head (36%)"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Seven (37%) persons who sustained injuries from celebratory gunfire were female, compared with three (13%) females"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "outbreak investigation", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The Puerto Rico Department of Health (PRDOH) invited CDC and local law enforcement agencies to assist in the investigation"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "A probable celebratory gunfire injury was defined as an unintentional firearm injury"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Cases were identified from newspaper and law enforcement reports and hospital and medical examiner records."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "were compared with the sex and age of 24 other persons with a noncelebratory gunfire injury"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "therefore, injury severity was not analyzed"}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["outcome_types", "analytic_depth"]}
